I'm an economist with the Government of Saskatchewan's Ministry of Finance. My work is macro forecasting and fiscal impact modelling: tracking where the province's economy is headed, and estimating what a shock, or a policy change, would cost.

I grew up in Ghana and studied economics at the University of Ghana and the University of Saskatchewan.

Here I play with data that catches my eye, and share the notebooks so you can too.

Rebuilt one of my notebooks, or got a different number? I'd love to hear from you: **[agyeponglawrence101@gmail.com](mailto:agyeponglawrence101@gmail.com)**

## Research

I've published on poverty, household spending and farm credit in Ghana. [See my papers →](research.qmd)
